principals.name: A
principals.description: Initiator. Generates I_A, encrypts for B, checks the response, and confirms B's value.

principals.name: B
principals.description: Responder. Decrypts A's request, generates I_B, replies to A, and checks the confirmation.

values.name: PKA
values.description: A's encryption key, deterministically corresponding to SKA.

values.name: PKB
values.description: B's encryption key, deterministically corresponding to SKB.

values.name: A
values.description: A's protocol identity, configured before the run.

values.name: B
values.description: B's protocol identity, configured before the run.

values.name: KAB
values.description: The pre-run symmetric key shared by A and B.
